message: Function returns values but type is not Result[T]

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' returns values but type is not Result[T]

rationale: Tuple returns are ambiguous. Callers must remember positional semantics. Typed results are self-documenting and statically analyzable. Fallible operations that raise or perform I/O SHALL return Result[T].
remediation: Return a typed Result[T] with is_success(), value, and message fields.

guidance.explanation: The correct version uses a typed Result[T]. The incorrect version returns a bare tuple where callers must remember positional semantics.
